name: invitation-card
title: Invitation card
description: An invitation you received: who sent it, what to and as which role, with Accept and Decline of equal weight and the outcome in words afterwards.
docs: inviter is { name, image? }, target is { name, type, image?, href? } (type is the kind of thing in lower case, workspace or project or team, and is written into the words) and role is the role in words. state is controlled (pending, accepted, declined or expired) with onStateChange, or leave it out and the card moves itself once your callbacks resolve; defaultState starts it elsewhere. Pending shows Accept and Decline as two buttons of the same size and style, a glyph each: while onAccept or onDecline runs neither answers a second press (both are aria-disabled, so the keyboard stays on the button that was pressed) and the pressed one is busy, and a rejection keeps the card pending and says so. Once a decision is made the keyboard moves to the outcome, so nobody has to Tab back from the top of the page. Accepted states the outcome and links to target.href (Open workspace). Declined says so and offers Undo for undoSeconds (default 10, 0 turns it off) through onUndo. expiresAt shows Expires in 5 days with the date; once it has passed, against now or the browser clock, the card shows itself expired whatever state says, explains why and offers Ask for a new invite when onRequestNew is given. Pass now to pin the clock for server HTML and tests. labels carries every word, with {inviter}, {role}, {target} and {type} filled in.
